title: Starting Premium for a HomeFlood Renewal When the Offer Has Been Overtaken
content:
**Rule.** For a HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies renewal booked as the next term, the premium the renewal term premium starts from is chosen on this ladder.

1. **Certificate entry.** When an Elevation Certificate entry was recorded after the renewal offer and carries a re-rated term premium, the renewal starts from the re-rated term premium of the latest such entry. That rating already uses the elevation the offer lacked.
2. **Endorsement entry.** When there is no such certificate entry but an endorsement entry was recorded after the renewal offer, the renewal starts from the revised full-term premium of the latest such endorsement. The offer predates that change.
3. **Renewal offer.** Otherwise, the renewal starts from the premium on the renewal offer.

**Reading the records.**
- "After the renewal offer" means recorded on a later date than the renewal offer entry for the coming term start. An entry recorded on the same day as the offer is not after it.
- "Latest" means the latest recorded date; where several share it, the one recorded first counts.

## Hypothetical cases

| Entries recorded after the offer | Starting premium |
|---|---|
| an Elevation Certificate entry with a re-rated term premium of 1,180.00, and an endorsement entry | 1,180.00 (the certificate entry) |
| an endorsement entry revising the full-term premium to 1,505.00, and no certificate entry | 1,505.00 |
| nothing (only entries recorded before or on the offer date) | the offer premium |
